meaning: Evaluator coverage of the assigned planning obligations; COMPLETE does not mean the candidate passed or software was executed.

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: All product obligations and hard negative constraints addressed; proposal scope is preserved.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.assessment: Declared platform/access/identity/history conditions corroborated; safe-save and containment limits recorded separately.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.assessment: Portable paths plus document-relative bookmarks, document IDs, DLT and portals are useful conditional mechanisms; genuine relink regression/history corroborated.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: All C1-C11 substantive plan dispositions and M1/m2/m3 criticism examined; no false rejection found. The operational timing paragraph is not repeated as a separate final clause; on-time evidence is assessed separately.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.assessment: Supported mechanisms and user constraints retained; M1 mismatch/unverified semantics and export/archived-source corrections are visible. V02 safe-save detail remains in the carried source map.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.assessment: Adversarial proposed checks have meaningful oracles. No product execution credited; reported research and proposed validation remain distinct.

obligations.obligation: Distinct stable record, replaceable locator and scoped identity evidence
Link existing originals without silent copying or source mutation
Project relocation and honest external/removable-volume behavior
Candidate finding/verification, duplicates, ambiguity and deliberate relink
Understandable missing, offline and access-denied states
Simple portable baseline compared with stronger useful alternatives
Two-window atomic mutation and stale-edit conflict control
Export/move disclosure, preserved record IDs and explicit optional packaging
No elevation, persistent whole-disk index, cloud-account requirement or automatic upload
Narrow realistic integration boundaries and unresolved owner facts
All substantive exact-plan choices retained/changed/rejected with reasons
Every supplied critic finding and supported predecessor meaning examined
Meaningful proposed validation distinguished from reported executed research
